name: lime cordial
instructions: Combine the clarified lime juice, white sugar, and lime peel in a saucepan. Bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Cover, reduce the heat to low, and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from the heat and let sit for 6 hours.
Strain the syrup and add the citric and malic acids, stirring until fully integrated. Bottle and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks. Makes 16 ounces.
